label: Read access control (Sync Gateway)
type: Sync Gateway's read-side gate: a document is visible to a user if and only if it is routed (via channel()) to a channel the user's computed all_channels includes. Enforced automatically by the platform on every read, unlike write access control.
note: 'Channels enforce read access control to the documents. Any user who has access to a document can update the document.' - the source's own statement of the read/write asymmetry.
